reason: The deployed frozen LERF interface is query-first canonical-negative Bernoulli relevancy, not raw positive cosine. A raw-cosine router would introduce another train/deploy contract mismatch. Exact fallback is also stronger and testable than a 0.9 initial prior.

router_correction.residual_attention: shared permutation-equivariant scorer over each residual slot
router_correction.zero_gate: clamp(softplus(raw_gate)-log(2),0,1), which is exactly zero at initialization and has derivative 0.5
